description: The risk attaches to the location. Choosing a different one means moving away from work, family and everything already built.
energy_note: Priced into your address before you arrived.

aspect: Insurance withdraws where it is needed
description: In high-risk areas cover becomes expensive, restricted or unavailable - so exposure rises exactly where protection falls away.
energy_note: Uninsurable, in the place you already live.

aspect: Recovery is a year of administration
description: Assessors, contractors, quotes, permits, temporary accommodation - all run from a kitchen that no longer exists.
Water reaches six inches. Everything below it goes: floors, plaster, wiring, the bottom of every cupboard. The house looks fine from outside and is uninhabitable for nine months.

aspect: Heat and cold are now events
description: A week of extreme temperature turns housing, transport and work into a problem for anyone with no adaptation available to them.

aspect: The second time is harder to insure
description: A claim marks the property, so the next policy is dearer or narrower, and the value of the house follows.
